provenance.source: PNOA, Instituto Geográfico Nacional (orthophoto of August 2024, 25 cm)
provenance.notes: Ends of the painted line across the main straight, just past the start gantry, from the pit wall side to the outer kerb, looking north-west in the direction of travel. Checked against GPS laps of this layout: every lap crosses it once and the fastest lap between crossings matches the logged best lap to 0.01 s; those traces run up to 15 m off the outer edge on this straight, so the check used the same line extended across the run-off.

Official figures: Grand Prix FIM layout 5,077 m, 16 turns, anticlockwise. The circuit also publishes the Grand Prix FIA layout (5,345 m) and the national layouts (2,626 m); they are not included yet because their gates have not been checked.
